The '''Colonies''', also known as the '''Colonies Regions''', was a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Due to its proximity to the galaxy's economic and political powerhouse, the Core Worlds, the Colonies was a largely wealthy region consisting of booming industrial worlds, trade centers, and garden worlds.

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the Colonies were among the first areas outside the Core to be colonized, some before the establishment of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and many worlds in the Colonies were founding members. The worlds here were typically heavily populated and industrialized, and had cultures that were as well established as the Core Worlds.<ref name="TEGTPAM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> The planets in the Colonies were extremely wealthy and highly developed, and could be referred to as export powerhouses. Many produced vast amounts of raw materials, particularly food and metals for the production of droids, starships, and military vehicles. Mining operations would often leave entire planets ravaged and bare.

Situated between the wealth of the Core and the production of the Rim, the Colonies were the economic heart of the galaxy; beings in the Colonies valued industry over of status and heritage. The Colonies also were the source of many problems within the Republic; questions about representation and resources, [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], [[slavery/Legends|slavery]], even separatism.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Circa [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]], the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] of [[Castell/Legends|Castell]] developed the [[Tumbledrive/Legends|tumble hyperdrive]], which allowed them to colonize several distant worlds including [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] in the Outer Rim. Most worlds in the Colonies section of "[[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]" were colonized by [[24,000 BBY]]. During the late [[Pre-Republic era]], several wealthy Core worlds in the [[Arrowhead]] colonized various worlds in this region through the use of [[Generation ship/Legends|generation ships]] and carved up interstellar empires. Settlers from [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]] colonized [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] while the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] colonized [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] and [[Loronar/Legends|Loronar]]. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] colonists settled on [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] and gradually evolved into a separate sub-species known as the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] by [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. Due to slow [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel and lack of communication, these colony worlds broke away from their colonial masters, and evolved in their own independent kingdoms and entities (such as the [[Tapani Empire]]), which sparked some conflict.<ref name="TEA" />

The formation of the Galactic Republic in [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] helped minimize conflict between the Core and breakaway Colony worlds, and expand colonization efforts within the region. This was greatly aided by the discovery of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Routes]], which led to the establishment of several new colony worlds including the shipyard base of Loronar, the [[Yabol Opa/Legends|Yabol Opa]], [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]], and the agrarian worlds of the [[Delle system/Legends|Delle system]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], the Duros on Neimoidia had established a few colony worlds known as the "[[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]]." One of these worlds, [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], joined the Republic that year.

The [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] with the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] served trade and the expansion of the Colonies to the [[Southern Core|southwest]], up to [[Kinyen system/Legends|Kinyen]]; a [[Khil]] wave of exploration formed the [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]] to the north of the ring.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]], the [[Arkanian Revolution]] occurred in [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] space when a non-interventionist faction rebelled against the radical geneticist [[Arkanian Dominion]]. The revolutionaries amassed an army of [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] created from merging the body parts of various species. However, the Dominion appealed to help from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the revolution was brutally put down. However, some of their cyborg creations survived, including the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Gorm (cyborg)|Gorm the Dissolver]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Ten years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] took advantage of an economic recession on Castell to take control of the planet. One Gossam named [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] used her aggressive business tactics to buy back Castell and gradually became the Guild's president.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Mai had each able Gossam serve as an indentured servant of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] for a portion of their lives in return for food, housing, and a modest income. Gradually, Castell recovered from the recession, but came under the influence of the Commerce Guild, which subsequently joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

During the Clone Wars, Neimoidia and the "purse worlds" were battlegrounds between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] towards the end of the war in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Under [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] reign, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was very forceful in controlling the Colonies, particularly developing a hard-line policy towards species and worlds that had supported the Confederacy. The Gossam species of Castell were a primary target of the Empire's [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] policies,<ref name="NEGAS" /> while in the same time funding generously its industries and corporations.<ref name="TEA" /> Consequently, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and its successor state the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] gained support in the region.<ref name="TEA" /> A great percentage of Colonies megacorporations and other operations greatly benefit from imperial contracts orchestrated to keep the region under control.<ref name="EOTE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> As part of its invasion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] from [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the Republic secured several undeveloped Colonies worlds as stepping stones.<ref name="TEGTPAM" /> Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Gossam were liberated from Imperial rule.<ref name="NEGAS" />
